evals.prompt: My pie chart is titled 'Monthly budget' with a legend at the bottom. Rent is 60%, food 22%, fun 10%, transport 8%. Fix the labels.
evals.expected_output: Rewrites the title as a finding, suggests direct labels, a unit, a dated source line, and one annotation.
assertions: Gives a title that states the finding
Recommends direct labels or a placed legend
Adds a source line with a date or asks for one

evals.prompt: Three of my slices are 2%, 2% and 1% and the labels overlap.
evals.expected_output: Suggests grouping into Other or moving labels outside with leader lines; says slices under 3 percent are unreadable.
assertions: Suggests grouping the small slices into Other or moving labels outside
Mentions leader lines or outside labels
Keeps the percents totaling 100 after grouping
Mentions what to do if the user needs each small slice named
